copy.headline: New citywide initiative asks Fort Worthians to volunteer 500,000 hours by April
copy.caption:

story.title: New citywide initiative asks Fort Worthians to volunteer 500,000 hours by April
story.summary: The effort is being spearheaded by city council member Michael Crain, United Way of Tarrant County and Junior League of Fort Worth. Earlier this month, Fort Worth City Council member Michael Crain announced a citywide initiative to volunteer 500,000 hours as a community by April of next year. He admits the number is random. Nevertheless, he wants to surpass it. “It’s not just about the goal of getting 500,000 hours. It’s really about a mindset that we as Fort Worthians have a duty to help each other, to help those that need it,” Crain said. The initiative, dubbed Fort Worth Serves, is being done in conjunction with United Way of Tarrant County, Junior League of Fort Worth and the city itself.
